icp: Creators who need text-to-speech: voiceover, narration, dubbing, and audiobook workflows, not dictation users.
pain: Creator tooling (n8n, video editors, podcast pipelines) already integrates the hosted ElevenLabs API shape; a local-first studio that does not speak that shape forces creators to keep paying per-character hosted prices.
revenueHypothesis: An ElevenLabs-compatible local endpoint makes Voice Studio a drop-in replacement in existing creator pipelines, converting hosted-API spend into Voice Studio adoption and future paid support.
mvpAcceptance: POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} accepts an ElevenLabs-shaped JSON body (text, model_id, voice_settings) and returns audio bytes
GET /v1/voices returns installed voice profiles in the ElevenLabs-shaped voices list
New pytest coverage for both endpoints passes with a mocked TTS backend and the existing router smoke suite still passes

publicPatternSources: ElevenLabs public API documentation request/response field shapes only; no proprietary code, assets, or branding copied

stopConditions: Stop after this single increment once the draft PR is open and independently verified
Stop if CI cannot run on the fork or the check run cannot be verified live
Stop if any change would touch LICENSE, store/marketplace paths, or public copy naming a person
rollback: Revert the single increment commit on branch helix/elevenlabs-compat-api and close the draft PR; no database or settings migrations are introduced.

vercel.exceptionReason: Voice Studio is a local-first desktop application (Tauri shell plus local FastAPI backend) that runs on the user's own machine; there is no hosted web deployment to verify on Vercel.
